confirmed.title: 需要確認（ask／waiting-consent 真相狀態）在遊玩場被降為「只點亮頭飾」，身體繼續追球
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/rig/stage.ts:61 (unchanged); the pinning test is apps/interaction-desktop/src/test/rig.test.ts:435-436 (finding wrote "rig.test.ts:434" — the file lives under src/test/, not companion/rig/)
confirmed.claim: `ask` 是 truthState 表情（runtime 真的在等 consent／input，machine PRIORITY requesting-consent=80、CPP §4.3 floor 80「可搶占任何非安全演出」），但 stage.ts 把它列進 OVERLAY_STATUS：遊玩中只覆蓋 STATUS_CHANNELS（core/headpiece/skirt/ear），ask.hold 的舉手、問號浮標、張嘴全部丟掉，且 playfieldActive() 回 true 讓她繼續追球／散步。使用者看到的是「在玩，頭飾亮一點」而不是「在等你確認」。同檔第 80–81 行註解把「需要確認」列在 takeover 名單，與程式碼自相矛盾；rig.test.ts:434 反而把 ask=overlay 釘死。
confirmed.evidence: stage.ts:53-63 `OVERLAY_STATUS = new Set([..., "ask", "listening"])`；stage.ts:66-74 STATUS_CHANNELS 只有 coreGlow/corePulse/headpieceGlow/skirtGlow/skirtTone/earL/earR；stage.ts:131-137 `playfieldActive` 對 overlay 回 true → stage.ts:664 stepWorld ambient=true 繼續遊玩。probe 實跑：`stageExpressionPlan("ask","chase")` → `{expression:"play-chase", useMachineSlice:false, statusChannels:{"headpieceGlow":0.8}}`；`EXPRESSIONS.ask.hold` = {armPose:"raise", armPhase:0.8, mouth:"open", overlay:"question", headpieceGlow:0.8,…} 只剩 headpieceGlow 存活。machine.ts:49-63 PRIORITY requesting-consent 80 > performing 25 的搶佔在 stage 被抵銷。stage.ts:80-81 註解：「takeover ＝ 整體搶佔（…成功、需要確認…）」。

verdicts.reasoning:
Reproduced on HEAD 2e02284 (worktree clean; stage.ts unchanged since that commit, `git log -S'"ask",'` shows it was introduced there).

Code facts (current file contents):
- stage.ts:53-63 `OVERLAY_STATUS` contains "ask"; stage.ts:66-74 STATUS_CHANNELS = coreGlow/corePulse/headpieceGlow/skirtGlow/skirtTone/earL/earR only.
- stage.ts:76-81 doc comment for the same function says takeover covers "…成功、需要確認…" — the code contradicts its own comment.
- stage.ts:131-137 `playfieldActive` returns true for any overlay state; stage.ts:283-296 `machineStageFlags` uses that for `ambient`; stage.ts:659-664 passes `ambient` into `stepWorld`, and playfield.ts:364 `canPlay = inputs.ambient && playEnabled && !quiet && !reducedMotion`, so play continues/starts while ask is active.
- machine.ts:305-306 maps `requesting-consent` → `{animation:"ask", ambient:false}` (machine explicitly says NOT ambient); machine.ts:52 PRIORITY requesting-consent=80. The stage layer overrides that `ambient:false` back to true. Both feed paths do this: CompanionApp.tsx (`syncPose` → machineStageFlags) and the CPP adapter shu.ts:108-114 (`stage.setMachineFlags(machineStageFlags(base, t, p.animation, p.ambient))`), and shuTables.ts:255-257 maps both `request-consent` and `ask` intents to the rig "ask" expression.
- expressions.ts:964-990 `ask` is `truthState:true` with hold {armPose:"raise", mouth:"open", overlay:"question", headpieceGlow:0.8, …}.

Probe run with vite-node (scratchpad/probe-ask.ts), actual output:
- statusOverlay("ask")=overlay; statusChannelParams(ask)={"headpieceGlow":0.8}
- stageExpressionPlan("ask", chase|stroll)={expression:"play-chase",useMachineSlice:false,statusChannels:{headpieceGlow:0.8}}; pounce→sneak-closer; carry→play-carry; sniff→curious
- playfieldActive("ask",false,false)=true; machineStageFlags("idle",{kind:"requesting-consent"},"ask",false)={ambient:true,frozen:false,…}
- machine reduce(idle)+requesting-consent → pose() = {animation:"ask", ambient:false}
- Rendered params at t=1500ms, ask+chase: armPose=down, mouth=cat, overlay=none, headpieceGlow=0.8; pure play-chase: headpieceGlow=0.25; pure ask: armPose=raise, mouth=open, overlay=question. So the only surviving cue is headpiece glow 0.25→0.8; the raised hand and question marker (the parts that actually say "需要確認") are dropped, and the body keeps chasing/strolling.

Mitigation check: no other in-window indicator in the normal path. gateway.ts:1143 `intentLine` (the "需要你確認" text) is only emitted via `systemText`, i.e. the substituted/failed fallback, not when the 小樞 adapter plays the intent; CompanionApp's "在等你確認" string (line 1125) only goes into the presence/Roll Call label, not the character. Existing test src/test/rig.test.ts:435-436 asserts `statusOverlay("ask")==="overlay"` (ran `vitest run src/test/rig.test.ts -t 組合式角色通道`: 4 passed), so the behaviour is pinned rather than guarded against.

Protocol/spec side: CPP §4.2 lists waiting-consent/waiting-input as Runtime-only truthStates; §4.3 gives request-consent floor 80 (distinct from wait/ask floor 60); §5 mixer says higher priority preempts. Spec §3.2 requires 小樞 to present waiting-for-consent from real events; §6.2 composition examples cover "work" states, not "需要確認". The prior run (2e02284-20260902T080415Z, findings companion-gameplay-070 / rig-renderer-045) raised the same defect but was left `unverified` (agent failure), and it is not recorded in CHANGELOG.md / docs/acceptance-evidence.md as a known limitation. Not a duplicate that was resolved, not fixed. Severity high is appropriate: this is the one truth state where the human's action is required, and it is rendered nearly indistinguishable from play — an honesty-ladder presentation defect (not a safety-authorization defect, so not blocker).

Verified at HEAD 2e02284 (clean tree, no drift). Ran a scratchpad vitest probe (no project files modified): stageExpressionPlan("ask","chase") and ("ask","stroll") both return {expression:"play-chase", useMachineSlice:false, statusChannels:{headpieceGlow:0.8}}; the ask.hold channels armPose/armPhase/earPerk/mouth/browL/browR/overlay("question")/tailAngle are all dropped because STATUS_CHANNELS (stage.ts:66-74) only carries core/headpiece/skirt/ear. machineStageFlags("idle",{kind:"requesting-consent"},"ask",false) → {ambient:true, frozen:false}, so stepWorld (stage.ts:664 ambient=this.flags.ambient) keeps canPlay true (playfield.ts:363-364): she continues or even starts chasing during the consent window; only in mode "free" does ask take over. This is a real inversion of documented priority, not style: expressions.ts:964-969 marks ask as truthState (runtime genuinely waiting for consent/input); machine.ts:52 requesting-consent=80 vs performing=25; docs/character-protocol/README.md:31 rule 5 explicitly lists waiting-consent among floor states that "可搶占任何非安全演出", §4.3 request-consent floor 80 vs play ≤50, §5 mixer "priority 高者可搶占"; stage.ts:80-81 comment itself lists 需要確認 under takeover; CHANGELOG.md:335-336 claims safety states "永遠搶占遊玩". rig.test.ts:435 pins the wrong behaviour, so no test guards it; not recorded as a known limitation. Severity lowered from high to medium: no honesty-ladder falsification (no fake success/verified), consent remains Rust-enforced and AI cannot grant it, fail-safe outcome is a missed/timed-out consent rather than an unsafe action, and the control-center projection (statusProjection.ts:97-102 「等你同意」, needsDecision) still surfaces the request in another window. It is a deterministic protocol/priority violation in the reference adapter with user-visible consequence (consent request reduced to a brighter headpiece while she plays), warranting a fix (move "ask" out of OVERLAY_STATUS) plus test flip.

confirmed.regressionTest: In src/test/rig.test.ts assert `statusOverlay("ask")==="takeover"`, `playfieldActive("ask",false,false)===false`, `stageExpressionPlan("ask","chase")` returns `{expression:"ask", useMachineSlice:true}` and `machineStageFlags("idle",{kind:"requesting-consent"},"ask",false).ambient===false`; generically, for every expression with `truthState:true`, `statusOverlay(id)` must not be "overlay". / In rig.test.ts assert statusOverlay("ask")==="takeover", stageExpressionPlan("ask","chase") deep-equals {expression:"ask", useMachineSlice:true, statusChannels:null}, and playfieldActive("ask",false,false)===false (and machineStageFlags("idle",{kind:"requesting-consent",untilMs:∞},"ask",false).ambient===false); move "ask" from the overlay list at rig.test.ts:435 to the takeover list.

confirmed.title: presence-set 只寫 prefs 不套用視窗，卻 ack `completed`（隱藏／顯示角色從未發生；tray 標籤跟著不一致）
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/CompanionApp.tsx:1062-1068 (unchanged); Rust lines drifted: desktop_prefs_patch = src-tauri/src/lib.rs:1618-1718, companion_apply_prefs = lib.rs:2271-2303, tray label = lib.rs:2573-2585, toggle_companion_window = lib.rs:1797-1829
confirmed.claim: Runtime 的 `companion.presence.set`（AI 可呼叫的 presentation actuator）在角色視窗端只呼叫 `desktop.prefsPatch({ companionVisible })`，而 Rust 的 `desktop_prefs_patch` 只驗證、存檔、同步 autostart，不 hide/show 視窗也不 emit；真正套用視窗的是另一個命令 `companion_apply_prefs`，這條路徑從未呼叫它。結果：presence-set visible:false 後視窗照樣顯示、visible:true 時隱藏的視窗也不會叫出來，但 ACK 回報 `completed`（誠實階梯：completed ≠ 效果發生）。副作用：prefs.companion_visible 與實際視窗狀態脫鉤，tray 選單文字依 prefs 顯示「顯示桌面角色」但角色明明在畫面上；之後任何無關的角色偏好變更觸發 companion_apply_prefs 時視窗才「突然」隱藏。
confirmed.evidence: CompanionApp.tsx:1062-1068：`if (plan.presence !== undefined && isTauri) { try { await desktop.prefsPatch({ companionVisible: plan.presence }); } catch ... }` 之後 `api.presentationAck(actionId, plan.outcome ...)`，plan.outcome 由 presentationCommands.ts:123 固定為 `"completed"`。desktop.ts:131-132 `prefsPatch → invoke("desktop_prefs_patch")`，:136 `companionApplyPrefs → invoke("companion_apply_prefs")` 是分開的命令。src-tauri/src/lib.rs:1615-1707 `desktop_prefs_patch`：驗證 → `supervisor::save_prefs` → autostart 同步 → 回傳，沒有任何 `get_webview_window("companion")`／hide/show/emit。lib.rs:2185-2216 `companion_apply_prefs` 才做 `ensure_companion_window`／`w.hide()`；grep 顯示 companion_apply_prefs 只被 pages（CompanionPage.tsx:145、FirstSuccess.tsx:167、Onboarding.tsx:195）呼叫，CompanionApp.tsx 沒有。lib.rs:2487-2499 tray 文字 `if companion_visible { "隱藏桌面角色" } else { "顯示桌面角色" }` 讀的是 prefs。HEAD 版（git show HEAD）同樣如此。docs/CHANGELOG 未記為已知限制。

verdicts.reasoning:
Verified against HEAD 2e02284 (working tree clean for all files involved; only .claude/workflows/*.js modified).

1. Path taken by `companion.presence.set`: CompanionApp.tsx:1062-1068 — `if (plan.presence !== undefined && isTauri) { await desktop.prefsPatch({ companionVisible: plan.presence }) }`, then line 1092 `api.presentationAck(actionId, plan.outcome, ...)`. `plan.outcome` is hard-coded `"completed"` at presentationCommands.ts:123 (existing test presentation.test.ts:75-82 asserts exactly that; ran it: 1 passed). No call to `desktop.companionApplyPrefs()` anywhere in CompanionApp.tsx (grep over src: callers are only desktop.ts:136 def, CompanionPage.tsx:145, FirstSuccess.tsx:167, pages/character/preferences.ts:143, Onboarding.tsx:195).

2. `desktop_prefs_patch` (lib.rs:1618-1718): merges patch → validates → `*prefs = candidate` → `supervisor::save_prefs` → autostart enable/disable → return JSON. No `get_webview_window("companion")`, no `.hide()/.show()`, no `app.emit`. All `.hide()`/`.show()` sites in lib.rs are: 1773 (apply_close_behavior), 1789 (show_main_window), 1809 (toggle_companion_window, tray only), 1905 (ensure_companion_window), 2300 (companion_apply_prefs). `ensure_companion_window` callers: 1807 tray toggle, 2287 companion_apply_prefs, 2318 companion_reset_position, 2805 startup. The 4s tray loop (lib.rs:2812-2819) only calls `refresh_tray` (labels + overlay), no visibility re-sync. No `prefs-changed`-style event exists (grep for emit("prefs…")/prefsChanged: none). So after presence-set, the window's visibility is untouched.

3. The project itself knows prefsPatch alone is insufficient: FirstSuccess.tsx:6 comment "prefsPatch({ companionVisible: true }) ＋ companionApplyPrefs", and firstSuccess.test.tsx:153 asserts both calls. CompanionApp's presence path is the one caller that skips step two.

4. Honesty-ladder impact: Runtime `presentation_ack` (crates/interaction-runtime/src/runtime.rs-side fn at presentation.rs:1010-1057) maps "completed" → Acknowledged → Completed with verdict AcknowledgedOnly and detail "companion surface confirmed presence-set render". The receipt reads `completed` while the window state is unchanged. The actuator is advertised to AI as "顯示／隱藏桌面角色視窗" (presentation.rs:724-731, requires_consent). For visible:false the strongest case needs no assumption about hidden WebViews: window is visible, SSE alive (CompanionApp.tsx:1181-1184 dispatches presentation.command unconditionally), prefsPatch succeeds, ack completed, window still on screen.

5. Secondary desync: tray label (lib.rs:2573-2585) reads `prefs.companion_visible` → shows "顯示桌面角色" while the character is still on screen; next unrelated `companion_apply_prefs` (e.g. any Companion page pref change) reads the stale `companion_visible=false` and hides the window "suddenly". Unlike `toggle_companion_window` (1811-1828), this path also never tells the Runtime via `presentation_hello_with_behavior(visible)`, though the heartbeat keeps reporting the true (still visible) state.

6. Not recorded as known limitation: grep for presence/companionVisible in CHANGELOG.md and docs/acceptance-evidence.md finds nothing relevant (only a v0.3 tray note at CHANGELOG:515). No test covers window application of presence-set (only the plan-level unit test).

Severity high stands: an AI-callable, consent-gated side-effect actuator returns `completed` for an effect that did not occur, plus persistent prefs/window/tray inconsistency. Fix is small (call `desktop.companionApplyPrefs()` after the patch, and mark failed if it throws), but the defect is real at HEAD.

親自對照目前工作樹（HEAD 2e02284＋未提交修改）逐條驗證，finding 成立；只有 lib.rs 行號漂移（desktop_prefs_patch 1618 起、companion_apply_prefs 2271 起、tray 文字 2573-2585），CompanionApp.tsx 行號未漂移。

證據鏈：
1. CompanionApp.tsx:1062-1068 presence-set 路徑只做 `await desktop.prefsPatch({ companionVisible: plan.presence })`，:1093 以 `plan.outcome` ack；presentationCommands.ts:119-123 對 presence-set 固定回 `{ outcome: "completed", presence }`。
2. desktop.ts:131-132 `prefsPatch → desktop_prefs_patch`，:136 `companionApplyPrefs → companion_apply_prefs`，兩者是獨立命令。
3. lib.rs:1618-1707 `desktop_prefs_patch`：合併 patch → 驗證 → `supervisor::save_prefs` → autostart 同步 → 回傳；沒有 `get_webview_window("companion")`、hide/show、也不 emit。`supervisor::save_prefs`（supervisor.rs:270-282）只是原子寫檔。
4. `ensure_companion_window` 的呼叫者只有 lib.rs:1807（tray toggle）、:2287（companion_apply_prefs）、:2318（companion_reset_position）、:2805（啟動）；`w.hide()` 只在 toggle_companion_window（:1808-1810）與 companion_apply_prefs（:2299-2301）。`companion_apply_prefs` 只被 CompanionPage.tsx:145、FirstSuccess.tsx:167、Onboarding.tsx:195、character/preferences.ts:143 呼叫，CompanionApp.tsx 從未呼叫。refresh_tray 的 `sync_overlay_window` 也不碰 companion 視窗。
5. Runtime 端契約明確期待「效果會發生」：presentation.rs:744-747 註解「presence-set 只需連線（把隱藏的角色叫出來是合法的）」，可用性閘門為 `bridge.connected` 而非 `accepts_input`；ack "completed" 後 presentation.rs:1035-1058 直接把 receipt 推到 Completed（verdict AcknowledgedOnly）。所以隱藏中的視窗收到 visible:true 只改 prefs、視窗照舊隱藏，卻回 completed；visible:false 同理視窗照舊顯示。這是誠實階梯違反（completed ≠ 效果發生；表面回執冒充執行結果）。
6. Tray 不一致：lib.rs:2573 讀 `prefs.companion_visible` 決定 :2581-2585 標籤文字，且 refresh_tray 是週期輪詢；presence-set false 後 prefs=false、視窗仍在畫面上，標籤會變成「顯示桌面角色」。原生 toggle 路徑（:1801-1828）同時 hide 視窗＋向 runtime 送 presentation_hello(visible=false) 讓 receptors 停止（spec §6.1 第 250 行），presence-set 路徑兩者皆無。
7. 歷史：cecbc92 引入時就是 fire-and-forget prefsPatch，從未接 companionApplyPrefs；git log -S"companionApplyPrefs" 在 CompanionApp.tsx 無任何提交。
8. 非已知限制：CHANGELOG.md、docs/acceptance-evidence.md、docs/FEATURES.md 對 presence-set 沒有「只寫偏好不套用視窗」的記錄；CHANGELOG:389 只寫 consent-gated 預設停用。
9. 測試未覆蓋：src/test/presentation.test.ts:75-82 只驗 plan 形狀（outcome/presence 欄位）；沒有任何 vitest／e2e 驗證視窗真的 hide/show；runtime 測試（presentation.rs:1156-1190）只驗 bridge 健康。

反駁嘗試：唯一緩解是 presence-set 為 consent-gated 且預設關閉（CHANGELOG:389），降低暴露面但不改變「使用者授權後 AI 呼叫 → 無效果卻 ack completed」的事實；runtime 標 AcknowledgedOnly 也只是誠實標「無獨立觀察者」，不能修正表面本身謊報。故維持 high。

confirmed.regressionTest: vitest CompanionApp integration test: mock `desktop.prefsPatch`/`desktop.companionApplyPrefs` spies and `api.presentationAck`; emit a runtime event `{eventType:"presentation.command", payload:{actionId:"a1", command:"presence-set", params:{visible:false}}}` and assert `companionApplyPrefs` was invoked before `presentationAck("a1","completed")`, and that when `companionApplyPrefs` rejects the ack outcome is "failed" (never "completed"). / vitest：以 mock desktop 掛載 CompanionApp（isTauri=true），送入 presentation.command presence-set {visible:false}，斷言 `desktop.companionApplyPrefs`（或專用 hide 命令）在 `api.presentationAck(actionId, "completed")` 之前被呼叫；若 apply 拋錯則 ack 必須是 "failed"。

confirmed.title: 桌面視窗在 Runtime 端斷線後永不重新 hello：presence 逾時或外部 daemon 重啟後，角色再也收不到 character.intent
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/CompanionApp.tsx:1228（未漂移；另見 :610、:958、:1208）；crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:1402-1406；crates/interaction-runtime/src/presentation.rs:966；crates/interaction-character/src/gateway.rs:1133-1137、:470、:1294-1305
confirmed.claim: Runtime 的 character_sweep_at 在桌面 presence 逾時（PRESENCE_STALE_SECS=20）時對 desktop-companion 做 on_disconnect（generation+1、connected=false、negotiated=None）；之後的 /v1/presentation/hello 心跳只呼叫 gateway.heartbeat()，不會重新登記。而桌面端只有在 feed 由 legacy→protocol 改變、fallbackToText、或 reduced-motion 變更時才會再送 /v1/character/hello（helloSentRef 只在 fallbackToText 重設）。因此 WebView 計時器被節流／睡眠喚醒時 sweep 先於心跳、或外部 daemon 重啟（transport 只重設 SSE cursor）之後，桌面角色永遠不在 connected_instance_ids() 裡：非安全 intent 靜默略過、安全 intent 只剩 character.system-text，/v1/character/instances 顯示 connected=false、provider 顯示「桌面角色（尚未連線）」，使用者看到的是一個不再演出的角色，沒有任何提示。
confirmed.evidence: crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:1404 `if gw.instance(&desktop).is_some_and(|v| v.connected) && !self.presentation.connected(now) { outputs.extend(gw.on_disconnect(&desktop, DisconnectReason::TransportClosed, now)); }`；crates/interaction-runtime/src/presentation.rs:966 presentation_hello_with_behavior 只做 `self.character_desktop_heartbeat(now)`（gateway.heartbeat 只更新 last_seen，不改 connected）。CompanionApp.tsx:1228 `if (feed === "protocol" && (feedChanged || !helloSentRef.current)) void sendHello(...)`，helloSentRef 只在 :610 設 true、:958（fallbackToText）設 false；poll 的 catch 分支只 apply offline，不重設 feedRef/helloSentRef；CompanionApp.tsx:1208 `if (e.eventType.startsWith("character.")) return;` 忽略 character.instance{connected:false}。src/transport.ts nextStreamCursor 偵測 daemon 重啟只重設 lastId/buffer。Rust 測試 character_loop.rs::desktop_presence_expiry_disconnects_the_desktop_instance 只驗證斷線後走 system.text，沒有任何測試驗證桌面會重連。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自逐檔核對（工作樹目前內容，行號與 finding 一致，未漂移）：

Runtime 端斷線後只有 hello 能恢復 connected：
- gateway.rs:1255-1290 on_disconnect → generation+1、connected=false、negotiated=None。
- gateway.rs:470 是全檔唯一的 `inst.connected = true`，位於 on_negotiate，只能經 character_hello（character.rs:792-841）到達。
- gateway.rs:1133-1137 heartbeat 只寫 `inst.last_seen`。presentation.rs:951-975 presentation_hello_with_behavior 對 gateway 只呼叫 character_desktop_heartbeat（character.rs:1378-1383 → gateway.heartbeat）。所以 /v1/presentation/hello 心跳永遠不會把桌面 instance 接回來。
- 斷線觸發有兩條：character.rs:1402-1406 presence 逾時（PRESENCE_STALE_SECS=20，presentation.rs:39）→ TransportClosed；以及 gateway.rs:1294-1305 sweep 本身 last_seen+45 s（wire.rs:33 DISCONNECT_AFTER_MS）→ HeartbeatTimeout。後者表示筆電休眠 >45 s 這種常見事件即會斷線（喚醒時 runtime.rs:1990-1993 的 1 s tokio interval 在程序內先 burst，WebView 的 10 s setInterval 還要跨 WebContent 程序 round-trip）。外部 daemon 重啟（lib.rs:2599-2653 External 模式確實存在）則是新程序根本沒有桌面 instance，確定性。

桌面端永不重送 character/hello：
- CompanionApp.tsx:572-614 sendHello，:610 helloSentRef=true；全部呼叫點只有 :790（reduced-motion 變更）、:795（開機）、:959（fallbackToText，:958 才重設 helloSentRef）、:1228（poll：feedChanged || !helloSentRef）。
- runtime.rs:473 status 永遠帶 characterProtocol 物件 → gatewayWiring.ts:43-47 selectRuntimeFeed 一直是 "protocol"，feedChanged 不會為真；poll 的 catch（:1255-1256）只 apply offline，不重設 feedRef/helloSentRef。

測試覆蓋：character_loop.rs:1534 desktop_presence_expiry_disconnects_the_desktop_instance 只驗到斷線；hello_negotiates_the_desktop_instance_and_rehello_bumps_generation 證明 runtime 支援 re-hello，但無任何 Rust／vitest／e2e 驗證桌面會重送（grep 全 repo 只有 api.ts 與 CompanionApp.tsx 提及 characterHello／sendHello）。無法實跑 Rust 測試：工作樹此刻因其他 agent 併行修改（agents.rs:312 缺 claim_id、runtime gateway.rs:285，agent.rs mtime 22:14）不編譯，與本 finding 無關；本結論依程式碼確定性推論。未見任何修復。

I attempted to refute this and could not; every link in the chain checks out against the current working tree (the character-protocol code is uncommitted v0.5 work; HEAD has no helloSentRef/sendHello at all).

Runtime side, verified by reading:
- character.rs:1403-1407: character_sweep_at calls gw.on_disconnect(desktop, TransportClosed) when the gateway thinks the desktop is connected but presentation presence is stale (PRESENCE_STALE_SECS=20, presentation.rs:39/241-246). on_disconnect (gateway.rs:1255-1290) sets connected=false, negotiated=None, generation+=1, lifecycle=Reconnecting.
- presentation.rs:954-976: presentation_hello_with_behavior only calls character_desktop_heartbeat(now) -> gateway.heartbeat (gateway.rs:1133-1137), which updates last_seen only. Even when conn_changed==true it just refreshes health and publishes PresentationState; nothing re-registers.
- `grep -n "connected = true"` in gateway.rs hits exactly one site: line 470 inside on_negotiate, reachable only via POST /v1/character/hello (character.rs:842-845). So a presence heartbeat can never bring the desktop back.
- Gateway instances live in an in-memory BTreeMap (gateway.rs:248); only adapter records are persisted (character.rs:75, 652). A daemon restart therefore loses the desktop instance entirely.
- connected_instance_ids (character.rs:548-555) filters connected && negotiated; character_project (1449-1467) drops non-safety intents and sends safety intents as character.system-text when targets are empty; character_ai_present (1630-1633) returns empty. Worse: the presentation actuator readiness gate (presentation.rs:746-754) uses presence (accepts_input), which is still true because heartbeats keep arriving, so AI state-present/animation-play actions are accepted, get a dispatched receipt, are skipped by the companion in protocol mode (CompanionApp.tsx:1042-1044), and can only end as uncertain via the ack watchdog.

Desktop side, verified by reading:
- helloSentRef (CompanionApp.tsx:277) is set true at :610 and reset false only at :958 (fallbackToText). The poll at :1228 only re-hellos when feed flips or helloSentRef is false; selectRuntimeFeed (gatewayWiring.ts:43-47) only checks that status.characterProtocol is an object, so feed stays "protocol" across a disconnect or a daemon restart. The poll catch (:1255-1257) only applies base=offline and does not touch feedRef/helloSentRef.
- :1208 returns early for every other character.* event, so character.instance{connected:false} is ignored.
- beat() (:1100-1153) calls api.presentationHello(...).catch(()=>{}) and ignores the response.
- grep for onRuntimeReady/onRuntimeError/onSupervisorState/supervisor in src/companion/ returns nothing; transport.ts nextStreamCursor (:359-376, :397-401) only resets cursor/buffer on daemon restart. companion-reload is emitted only from companion_apply_prefs (src-tauri lib.rs:2298, user pref change) and its live path does not hello. The only other re-hello triggers are the reduced-motion media-query change (:780-791) and fallbackToText.
- No vitest test references characterHello/helloSent (grep over src/test and e2e empty). The Rust test desktop_presence_expiry_disconnects_the_desktop_instance (character_loop.rs:1534-1569) only asserts the disconnect side.

Spec/protocol basis (not just style): docs/character-protocol/README.md:322 states explicitly that after presence expiry the runtime emits character.instance{connected:false} and "視窗必須重新 /v1/character/hello"; README:243 requires external adapters to re-hello on every reconnect; spec lines 398/774 list reconnect and 斷線/恢復 as acceptance items. The desktop window never satisfies this.

Triggers are realistic: (a) external-daemon restart is deterministic (in-memory instance lost, no re-hello); (b) sleep/wake or any >20s heartbeat gap: the watchdog runs on a 1s tokio interval (config.rs:52, default Burst missed-tick behavior) with Utc::now(), so the sweep will typically fire before WebKit resumes the 10s setInterval. Not an invariant violation of the honesty ladder itself (runtime honestly reports connected=false, provider shows 尚未連線, safety intents fall back to system-text), but a documented protocol requirement is violated and the primary character surface silently stops performing with no recovery; "high" is appropriate.

Note: I could not execute the Rust test because the working tree currently fails to compile on unrelated parallel edits (crates/interaction-runtime/src/gateway.rs:420/484/490/501 `claimed_or_failed`, agents.rs:312/814 `claim_id`); the conclusion rests on direct code reading of the cited files, which are not touched by those errors.

confirmed.title: 拖放「記錄這些項目」在 protocol 模式一律失敗：TS 送 `{files:[…]}`，Rust 正規化器只接受 README §6 的扁平鍵

confirmed.claim: TS Gateway 把 character.file-dropped 正規化成 payload `{ files: FileDropGrant[] }`；Rust InputNormalizer 對 FileDropped 要求 payload 只含 name/mediaType/bytes/readableScope/grantId/expiresAt，出現任何其他鍵即 Dropped(InvalidPayload)。CompanionApp 的 dropPush 在 protocol 模式把事件經 gateway.ingestInput → POST /v1/character/events 送給 Runtime，Runtime 回 decision=dropped、reason=invalid-payload，dropPush 擲錯，recordDroppedItems 顯示「記錄失敗…（這些項目沒有被記錄）」。也就是 v0.5 daemon 下的桌面拖放記錄功能整條路徑是死的（誠實報失敗，但功能不可用）；TS 還把未知的 bytes／mediaType 補成 0／application/octet-stream（假資料）。兩邊各自的單元測試只驗自己的形狀，沒有跨實作的 fixture 測試。
confirmed.evidence: gateway.ts:1282 `payload = { files };`（fileGrants 回 FileDropGrant[]）；gatewayWiring.ts:643 `payload: { files }`；CompanionApp.tsx:1540-1546 `inputEventFor("companion-dropped", facts)` → `if (result.decision === "dropped") throw new Error(...)`。crates/interaction-character/src/input.rs:218 `const FILE_DROP_KEYS: [&str; 6] = ["name","mediaType","bytes","readableScope","grantId","expiresAt"]`、:394 `.find(|k| !FILE_DROP_KEYS.contains(&k.as_str()))` → `InputDropReason::InvalidPayload`。實測（scratch 程式呼叫 InputNormalizer::push 餵 TS 形狀）：`PROBE1 ts-shape file-drop -> Dropped(InvalidPayload { field: "files" })`。Rust 測試 character_loop.rs:948-975 用扁平鍵；TS 測試 character-gateway.test.ts:752 用 files 陣列。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自追完整條路徑並以 scratch 程式重現，主張成立，行號無漂移（工作樹與 finding 一致）。

1. TS 送出的形狀：`apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/gatewayWiring.ts:641-645` `inputEventFor("companion-dropped")` 回 `{ kind: "character.file-dropped", payload: { files: [{name}] } }`（只有檔名）；`apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/gateway.ts:1279-1284` `case "character.file-dropped"` → `payload = { files }`，`fileGrants`（:1359-1389）對每個檔案補 `mediaType` 缺省 `"application/octet-stream"`（:1371-1374）、`bytes` 缺省 `0`（:1375）。`deliver`（:1410-1411）把整個 event 交給 `opts.onInput`；`CompanionApp.tsx:721-726` onInput → `api.characterEvent` → `transport.ts:238-239` POST `/v1/character/events`（或 Tauri `character_bridge.rs:83-89` 直接 `serde_json::from_value` 後呼叫 `rt.character_event`，兩條路都不轉換 payload）。

2. Rust 端：`crates/interaction-api/src/routes.rs:1664-1675` → `crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:945-993` `character_event` → `crates/interaction-character/src/gateway.rs:1056-1080` `on_event` 只做世代／instance／版本檢查後直接 `inst.input.push(event, …)`；`crates/interaction-character/src/input.rs:218-225` `FILE_DROP_KEYS` 只有六個扁平鍵，`:391-399` 任何額外鍵即 `Dropped(InvalidPayload{field})`。`files` 不在白名單（也不在 `FORBIDDEN_PATH_KEYS`，所以會走到這一步）。

3. 重現：scratch 專案（path dep 到 interaction-character，未動 repo）呼叫 `InputNormalizer::new(PrimaryCompanion, InputLimits::default()).push(...)`，餵 TS 形狀 `{"files":[{name,mediaType,bytes,readableScope:"file",grantId,expiresAt}]}` → 輸出 `Dropped(InvalidPayload { field: "files" })`，序列化為 `{"decision":"dropped","reason":"invalid-payload","field":"files"}`；同一 normalizer 餵 README §6 扁平形狀 → `Queued`。`character_event` 對 Dropped 回 `{"decision":"dropped","reason":"invalid-payload"}`。

4. 使用者可見結果：`CompanionApp.tsx:1536-1551` `dropPush` 在 protocol 模式（`selectRuntimeFeed` 在 `/v1/status` 有 `characterProtocol` 時回 "protocol"，`runtime.rs:473` v0.5 daemon 一定帶）等待 forward，`result.decision === "dropped"` 即 throw；`recordDroppedItems`（:2054-2081）catch 後顯示「記錄失敗：…（這些項目沒有被記錄）」。沒有 fallback 到 legacy pushObservation。故 v0.5 daemon 下「記錄這些項目」必定失敗（誠實回報，但功能全死）。

5. 測試覆蓋缺口屬實：Rust `character_loop.rs:948-975` 只測扁平鍵；TS `character-gateway.test.ts:752-780` 與 `companion-gateway-wiring.test.ts:270-274` 只斷言 `files` 陣列形狀（後者甚至斷言 `application/octet-stream`/`bytes: 0` 的補值）；`crates/interaction-api/tests`、`tests/e2e`、`apps/interaction-desktop/e2e` 完全沒有 file-dropped 的跨實作 fixture。文件 `docs/character-protocol/README.md:220` 規定扁平 `{name, mediaType, bytes, readableScope, grantId, expiresAt}`，Rust 依文件、TS 違反文件。

6. 非重複／未修：前一輪 `docs/reviews/adversarial/2e02284-20260902T080415Z.json` 同題 091 verdict 為 "unverified"（無 verdicts），`CHANGELOG.md`／`docs/acceptance-evidence.md` 無此已知限制記錄，目前工作樹檔案仍為上述內容。severity high 合理：核心互動功能在正式協定模式整條不可用，且 TS 端以 0／octet-stream 冒充未知的 bytes／mediaType（違反「unknown 不演」）。

親自驗證，無法反駁，結論為確認缺陷（以目前工作樹為準；Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock 等未提交變更早於我的驗證，非我造成，probe 已刪除、repo 未動）。

契約兩端證據：
1. TS 送出形狀：gateway.ts:1280-1282 對 `character.file-dropped` 設 `payload = { files }`，`files` 來自 fileGrants（gateway.ts:1359-1391），每筆為 `{name, mediaType, bytes, readableScope:"file", grantId, expiresAt}`；未知時補 `mediaType="application/octet-stream"`、`bytes=0`（gateway.ts:1371-1375）。gatewayWiring.ts:640-643 `inputEventFor("companion-dropped")` 只給 `{ files:[{name}] }`，所以桌面拖放實際送出的每個檔案都是 bytes 0／octet-stream。
2. 轉送不做任何變形：CompanionApp.tsx:722-726 `onInput` 直接 `api.characterEvent(PRIMARY_INSTANCE_ID, event)` → api.ts:272 invoke → transport.ts:239 `POST /v1/character/events {instanceId, event}`。
3. Rust 端：routes.rs:1636-1638 反序列化為 `CharacterInputEvent`（payload 為 BTreeMap）→ runtime character.rs:945-1000 `character_event` → gateway.rs:1078 `inst.input.push` → input.rs:390-398 對 FileDropped 找到任何不在 `FILE_DROP_KEYS`（input.rs:218-225，扁平六鍵）的鍵即 `Dropped(InvalidPayload{field})`。grep `"files"` 於 crates/interaction-character/src/gateway.rs 與 crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs 均無命中，沒有任何展開 files 陣列的邏輯；runtime character.rs:1983-2002 的觀察映射也只讀單檔扁平鍵（fileCount 固定 1）。
4. 實測：在 scratchpad 建獨立 crate 以 path 依賴 interaction-character，呼叫 `InputNormalizer::push`：TS 形狀 `{files:[{…六鍵…}]}` → `Dropped(InvalidPayload { field: "files" })`；README §6 扁平形狀 → `Queued`。`InputDropReason` 以 `#[serde(tag="reason", rename_all="kebab-case")]` 序列化，runtime 回 `{decision:"dropped", reason:"invalid-payload"}`。
5. 使用者可見結果：dropPush（CompanionApp.tsx:1536-1551）在 `result.decision === "dropped"` 時 throw，recordDroppedItems（2054-2081）顯示「記錄失敗：invalid-payload（這些項目沒有被記錄）」。protocol 模式在 status 帶 `characterProtocol` 時即選定（gatewayWiring.ts:43-47），也就是 v0.5 daemon 的預設路徑；只有舊 daemon 才走 `api.pushObservation`。
6. 測試覆蓋缺口屬實：Rust tests/character_loop.rs:948-961 用扁平鍵；TS character-gateway.test.ts:752-776 與 companion-gateway-wiring.test.ts:270-273 都斷言 `{files:[…]}`；e2e/*.spec.ts 無 file-drop 案例；沒有跨實作 fixture，所以兩邊各自綠燈卻互不相容。

規格對照：docs/character-protocol/README.md:220 明文「`file-dropped` 只帶 `{name, mediaType, bytes, readableScope, grantId, expiresAt}`」，TS 端違反這個線上契約；Rust 端是契約的忠實實作。誠實階梯本身沒被違反（失敗誠實顯示、未假稱已記錄），但 CHANGELOG 宣告的「拖放」語意受器在 v0.5 預設模式下整條路徑不可用，是功能性契約破裂而非風格偏好，維持 high。bytes=0／octet-stream 補值屬次要（Rust 要求 bytes 為 u64，TS 只能補值），修復時應一併改為不知即不送或改契約允許缺省。

證據鏈（目前檔案內容）：

親自驗證（工作樹目前版本，stage.ts 的 diff 只新增 pause/resume，OVERLAY_STATUS 與 STATUS_CHANNELS 未變）：

1. 程式路徑成立：machine.ts:474-475 把 agent.session.state waiting-input／waiting-consent 投成 requesting-consent（priority 80），pose() 回 animation "ask"（machine.ts:305-306）；CompanionApp.syncPose（502-511）與 character/adapters/shu.ts:107-114 都把 p.animation="ask" 餵給 machineStageFlags → playfieldActive → statusOverlay。stage.ts:53-63 OVERLAY_STATUS 含 "ask"，所以 statusOverlay("ask")="overlay"。

5. 反駁點檢查：(a) 規格 §6.2 的組合範例是「核心顯示 Agent 工作中」，並未授權把 consent 降成頭飾光；(b) 現有測試 rig.test.ts:435 是把 ask 釘成 overlay（固化缺陷），regressions-phase7 #11 只保護「AI 不能點播 ask」，沒有任何測試保護「ask 搶占遊玩」；(c) gateway 的 system.text 退路（gateway.ts:1133-1155）只在 unsupported/reduced 時觸發，shu adapter 宣稱支援 ask（shuTables.ts:255-257），所以不會補文字；shu.ts 也沒有 bubble；Roll Call「在等你確認」需 hover 才看得到。

嚴重度下修為 medium 而非 high：這不是偽造 verified／解除 estop 的權限主權問題，runtime 仍照常等待 consent、AI 沒有自我授權；控制中心頁面（statusProjection NEEDS_CONSENT，needsDecision:true，Home/Work/Activity 皆消費）仍會顯示需要決定。但 tray.rs 無 consent 指示，桌面角色作為主要常駐面時，floor 80 的真相狀態被降成一個與 working 同值的頭飾光，確實違反 CPP 第 5 條與檔案自身契約，是真實可修的誠實呈現缺陷（把 "ask" 移出 OVERLAY_STATUS，並改 rig.test.ts:435 的斷言）。

On the Rust side spawn_companion_clickthrough (lib.rs:2085-2098) has only this one rect: on_character = cursor within rect → want_ignore=false, so the whole union rectangle blocks click-through; there is no toy/character-aware second test. Because HIT_RECT_MIN_INTERVAL_MS=50/MAX_QUIET=60 and the poll is 80 ms, the rect tracks the cursor in practice; if the cursor outruns it the last union rect stays as a dead zone until the toy expires (TOY_TTL_MS=150_000) or is cleared. This contradicts CHANGELOG.md:328 (「hit-rect 隨角色與玩具動態更新…空白區維持點擊穿透」). No existing test covers interactiveBounds (grep src/test shows only hitRectReportPolicy/charHitRect), and it is not recorded as a known limitation in CHANGELOG or docs/acceptance-evidence.md. confirmed.title: idle→lie-flat 頭部仍單幀瞬移 21 px：blendPose 的 260 ms 窗口在 lie-flat 600 ms enter 中途就結束，把 poseBlend 硬覆寫成 1
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/rig/timeline.ts:409-412 (no drift; line 410 is `const kp = clamp((now - this.switchAt) / POSE_TRANSITION_MS, 0, 1);` at HEAD 2e02284)
confirmed.claim: poseBlend 機制只對「hold 立即是 lie」的表情有效（sleep）。lie-flat 的 enter 在 450 ms 才把 pose 從 crouch 切成 lie，此時 `(now-switchAt)/POSE_TRANSITION_MS` 早已 ≥1，blendPose(from=stand,to=lie,kk=1) 把 evalPhase 算好的 poseBlend≈0.5 覆寫成 1，頭中心從 mixLayout 的 70.7 直接跳到 lieLayout 的 92.0。CHANGELOG:155 宣稱「poseBlend 通道消除 lie↔stand 頭部瞬移」不成立；此路徑由 Director ambient `lie-flat`（shuTables SHU_AMBIENT_VARIANTS）與微動作 `lie` 正常觸發。
confirmed.evidence: timeline.ts:409-412 `const kp = clamp((now - this.switchAt) / POSE_TRANSITION_MS, 0, 1); params = blendPose(this.prevSnapshot, target, params, kp);`；params.ts:362-366 `pose: kk >= 0.5 ? to.pose : from.pose, poseBlend: kk < 0.5 ? 1 - kk : kk`（kk=1 → poseBlend=1，無視 target.poseBlend）；expressions.ts:123-131 lie-flat enter 600ms：kf(0 stand)→kf(0.5 crouch)→kf(1 lie)。probe（60fps 逐幀量 layoutFor().hy+bodyBob+nod）：`idle -> lie-flat: worst 21.33px at +617ms, 70.7->92.0 pose=lie blend=1.00`；對照 `idle -> sleep` 只有 2.97px、`sleep -> idle` 2.96px。

verdicts.reasoning:
Reproduced independently at HEAD 2e02284 with a frame-by-frame probe (vitest, node env, 60 fps, same method as the existing test at src/test/regressions-phase7.test.ts:894 but in the idle→lie-flat direction, measuring layoutFor(tl.paramsAt(t), RIG_PALETTES["maid-classic"]).hy):

idle -> lie-flat: worst 21.33px at +617ms, 70.7->92.0, prev frame (crouch, poseBlend 0.53) -> cur frame (lie, poseBlend 1.00)
sit -> lie-flat: worst 20.89px at +600ms, 71.1->92.0
idle -> sleep: 2.95px; sleep -> idle: 2.95px; lie-flat -> idle: 2.95px (these work because the pose flips at switchAt, so kp runs 0→1 in step).

Trace of idle→lie-flat: +467..+600ms head descends smoothly 52.9→70.7 (evalPhase/lerpParams already produces a continuous poseBlend 0.98→0.53 across the crouch→lie keyframe pair, params.ts:339-342), then at +617ms pose flips to "lie" and poseBlend is 1.00 → 92.0. Mechanism exactly as claimed: idle's exit is 160 ms (expressions.ts idle exit phase), so switchAt=160; lie-flat's enter (expressions.ts:123-131, 600 ms, kf 0 stand → 0.5 crouch → 1 lie) only makes target.pose="lie" at t≥0.75 ⇒ now≥610 ms; by then kp=(610-160)/260≈1.73→1, and blendPose (params.ts:353-367) returns `{...params, pose: to.pose, poseBlend: 1}`, discarding the ~0.47 poseBlend that evalPhase computed.

Causal attribution verified by counterfactual: vi.mock-ing blendPose to identity (file-scoped) drops idle→lie-flat worst jump from 21.33 px to 6.00 px (the pre-existing stand→crouch 6 px hard cut at +317ms, which is the kind of body-shape cut acknowledged in docs/acceptance-evidence.md:486 #10). So the 21 px teleport is introduced by the blendPose override at timeline.ts:411, not by evalPhase.

Reachability: src/character/adapters/shuTables.ts:50 ambient variant `lie-flat` (weight 2, minRelax 0.85), shuTables.ts:124 micro-action `lie-down` → animation "lie" → EXPRESSION_ALIASES lie→"lie-flat" (expressions.ts:1348), and src/character/spriteIntents.ts:35 `sleep: "lie"`. Stage path is timeline.paramsAt → layoutFor (stage.ts:706, draw.ts) with no further pose smoothing (the walking branch at stage.ts:719 only applies when not useMachineSlice and moving).

Not covered by existing tests: regressions-phase7.test.ts #15 tests blendPose unit behavior, layoutFor blending, lie-flat→idle (max jump <12) and Reduced Motion; there is no idle/sit→lie-flat frame-continuity test, so the defect is not caught. Not fixed (file unchanged). Not recorded as a known limitation (acceptance-evidence.md:486 #10 only mentions stand↔sit ~10 px body-shape cut). CHANGELOG.md:155 "`poseBlend` 通道消除 lie↔stand 頭部瞬移" is therefore only true for the lie→stand direction and for expressions whose hold pose is lie from the first enter frame (sleep, doze-like); for lie-flat's animated enter the head still teleports ~21 logical px (≈ one head radius, hry=19) in a single frame.

Severity: cosmetic presentation defect on a frequently reachable ambient plus a CHANGELOG claim that overstates the fix; no safety/honesty invariant involved, so medium rather than high.

Independently reproduced at HEAD 2e02284; the finding's numbers are exact and the mechanism is as described.

Code path (verified by reading, no drift):
- expressions.ts:123-131 `lie-flat` enter = 600 ms, kf(0 stand) → kf(0.5 crouch) → kf(1 lie). evalPhase/lerpParams (params.ts:326-343) flips the pose string at the segment midpoint, so `target.pose` becomes "lie" only at t≥0.75 of enter = 450 ms after switchAt; before that lerpParams sets target.poseBlend to ramp 1→0.5 (crouch side), then 0.5→1 (lie side) — on its own this would be continuous (hy 52→72 then 69→92).
- timeline.ts:410-411 then applies `kp = clamp((now - switchAt)/POSE_TRANSITION_MS(260), 0, 1)` and `blendPose(prevSnapshot, target, params, kp)`. While target.pose is crouch, blendPose is a no-op (neither side is lie). The instant target.pose becomes lie (450 ms > 260 ms so kp is already 1), blendPose (params.ts:352-367) unconditionally writes `pose: "lie", poseBlend: 1`, discarding the ~0.5 poseBlend evalPhase had computed. layoutFor (draw.ts:91-101) therefore snaps from mixLayout(lie, crouch, 0.53).hy≈70.7 straight to lieLayout().hy=92.
- RigRenderer (renderer.ts:61-67) feeds timeline.paramsAt straight into drawRig, so nothing downstream re-blends; StageRenderer's poseBlend:1 at stage.ts:722 is a separate walking-secondary-motion branch, not a fix for this.

Empirical probe (vitest, scratchpad config, 60 fps, |Δ layoutFor().hy| and hy+bodyBob per frame, 3 s settle in `from` then setAnimation(to)):
- idle → lie-flat: worst 21.33 px at +617 ms (70.7→92.0, pose=lie, blend=1.00); frame trace +517…+600 ms shows hy 59.6→70.7 with pose=crouch blend 0.81→0.53, then +617 ms hy=92.0 blend=1.00.
- idle → "lie" (alias, expressions.ts:1348): identical 21.33 px.
- sit-quiet → lie-flat: identical 21.33 px.
- Controls: idle → sleep 2.95 px; sleep → idle 2.95 px; lie-flat → idle 2.95 px (sleep has no hand-written enter, so target.pose is lie from t=0 and the 260 ms linear kp works as designed).
(+617 ms = idle's 160 ms hand-written exit at expressions.ts:90 + 450 ms pose flip, rounded to the 16.7 ms frame grid.)

Reachability: SHU_AMBIENT_VARIANTS has `lie-flat` (shuTables.ts:50, minRelax 0.85, cooldown 150 s) and SHU_MICRO_ACTIONS has `lie-down` → animation "lie" (shuTables.ts:124) → alias lie-flat. So this is the normal "lie down" path, not an edge case.

Existing coverage: regressions-phase7.test.ts §"#15 lie ↔ stand 不再單幀瞬移" (lines 872-917) only measures lie-flat → idle (<12 px) and the Reduced-Motion case; the idle → lie-flat direction is untested, which is why CHANGELOG.md:155 ("`poseBlend` 通道消除 lie↔stand 頭部瞬移") and acceptance-evidence.md:486 overstate the fix — it holds for lie→stand and for sleep, not for the lie-flat enter.

Severity: this is not a CLAUDE.md invariant breach (no honesty-ladder, safety, consent, or authority impact) — it is a visible presentation defect (~21 px, ≈17% of the 128 px logical canvas, in one frame) on a regularly reachable ambient path, contradicting a "Fixed" changelog claim and the project's own <12 px acceptance threshold. I rate it medium rather than high: real and must be fixed or honestly re-worded in CHANGELOG/acceptance-evidence, but cosmetic in effect and limited to one direction of one pose family.

confirmed.title: presentation `cancel`（單一 actionId、AI 可呼叫）與 estop `clear-all` 無差別清掉 blocked／failed／unknown 與安全氣泡
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/CompanionApp.tsx:1026-1036 (branch starts at 1026, not 1027; file unchanged at HEAD 2e02284)
confirmed.claim: Rust 端 `cancel` 是「針對某個仍在等 ACK 的 presentation action」帶 actionId 送出，但角色視窗的 handler 忽略 actionId，一律 stopSpeech、清掉所有氣泡（含被擋下／失敗／未知的固定安全文字與 sticky 緊急氣泡）並 `clear-transient`；而 machine 的 `clear-transient` 對 SAFETY_TRANSIENTS 也無條件清除。AI 用同一把 token 走 `POST /v1/actions/{id}/cancel` 或 `interaction.cancel` 取消自己一則尚未 ACK 的 `companion.speak`（ACK 要等語音講完，最長 9 秒），就能把同時在台上的 blocked／failed／unknown 表演與其安全氣泡提早抹掉。另外緊急停止時每個 presentation actuator 的 emergency_stop 會先送 `clear-all`，`emergency.stop` 事件之後才發，所以「安全訊息本身留著」（regressions-phase7 #8 釘死的意圖）在真實流程中被前一步的 clear-all 先清光。
confirmed.evidence: CompanionApp.tsx:1027-1036：`if (command === "cancel" || command === "clear-all") { ... stopSpeech(); showBubbleRaw(null, 0); if (cancelPlan.transient === null) apply({ type: "clear-transient" }); return; }`（actionId 只在 1026 取出，這個分支完全不用）。machine.ts:249-250 `case "clear-transient": return { ...state, transient: null };`（不看 SAFETY_TRANSIENTS，機器 base 為 idle 時 blocked/failed/unknown 直接歸零）。presentation.rs:794-808 `cancel(action_id)`：`if self.bridge.take_pending(action_id).is_some() { publish PresentationCommand {actionId, command:"cancel"} }`；runtime.rs:820-829 `cancel_action` → `actuator.cancel(action_id)`；interaction-api/src/lib.rs:263 `.route("/v1/actions/{id}/cancel", post(routes::action_cancel))`、routes.rs:724 `"interaction.cancel"`。speakText 的 ACK 在 CompanionApp.tsx `if (plan.speech) await speakText(plan.speech)` 之後才送，最長 9s。presentation.rs:811-828 emergency_stop 無條件 publish `clear-all`；runtime.rs:889-896 actuator emergency_stop 迴圈在 `self.events.emit(EventType::EmergencyStop, ...)`（runtime.rs ~924）之前。regressions-phase7.test.ts:625-636「安全訊息本身留著（被擋下/失敗/未知不是要被藏起來的東西）」只測 reduce(base emergency)，沒測前置的 clear-all。

verdicts.reasoning:
Verified against the current tree (HEAD 2e02284, source files clean) and reproduced with a scratch vitest run.

Confirmed — the cancel half (AI-reachable):
- /Users/user/Workspace/claude-lab/adaptive-interaction/apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/CompanionApp.tsx:1026-1036: `if (command === "cancel" || command === "clear-all") { ... stopSpeech(); showBubbleRaw(null, 0); if (cancelPlan.transient === null) apply({ type: "clear-transient" }); return; }`. `actionId` (line 1025) is never used in this branch. `showBubbleRaw` (351-359) unconditionally `setBubble(null)` on the single bubble slot — the same slot that `maybeBubble` (1397-1417) uses for the fixed safety wording `line("blocked"|"unknown"|"failed")` shown for 5000 ms with `{safety:true}`.
- presentationCommands.ts:87-89: `case "cancel": case "clear-all": return { outcome:"completed", transient:null, bubble:null }` → `clear-transient` is always applied.
- machine.ts:249-250: `case "clear-transient": return { ...state, transient: null }` — no SAFETY_TRANSIENTS check (line 149 defines blocked/failed/unknown as safety transients). Scratch test (root=scratchpad, imports machine.ts/presentationCommands.ts by absolute path) passed: blocked/failed/unknown on idle base + planPresentationCommand("cancel") → transient null, pose "idle".
- The code comment at 1028-1029 ("safety poses are driven by base state, not by presentation commands") is factually wrong for blocked/failed/unknown: they are transients, not base states, so the wipe is unintended, not designed.
- Protocol mode (the v0.5 default: runtime status always carries `characterProtocol` object, runtime.rs:473 / character.rs:746-758 → selectRuntimeFeed = "protocol") is NOT a mitigation: the shu adapter drives intents through the same machine via `mixerPort` (CompanionApp.tsx:513-520; shu.ts:318 `mixer.apply(applied)`), and `maybeBubble(e)` still runs for legacy events in both feeds (1225-1228). So both the safety pose and the safety bubble are wiped in both modes.
- AI can trigger it: `POST /v1/actions/{id}/cancel` (interaction-api/src/lib.rs:263 → routes.rs:402 `action_cancel`, no ownership check) and tool `interaction.cancel` (routes.rs:724) → runtime.rs:820-829 `cancel_action` → presentation.rs:794-808 `cancel`: `if take_pending(action_id).is_some() { publish PresentationCommand{command:"cancel"} }`. A pending exists for the whole duration of: `companion.speak` (ack only after `await speakText` at CompanionApp.tsx:1081, ≤9 s; needs consent) and, more importantly, `companion.animation.play`/`state.present` which need NO consent (presentation.rs:685-697, RiskClass::Low, no requires_consent) and in protocol mode are settled only when the adapter receipt is terminal (character.rs:1789-1795 `if receipt.is_terminal()` → Settlement → presentation_ack → take_pending), i.e. for the full animation duration (ACK_TTL_MS 10 s cap). An AI that keeps an animation pending and cancels it when it sees `plan.blocked` on SSE can systematically erase the "被擋下/失敗/未知" pose+text from the companion surface. The receipts/events/control center remain honest, so the harm is limited to the companion surface — hence medium, not high.
- Not covered by tests: companion.test.ts:271-287 only asserts cancel clears `performing`; no test asserts safety transients/bubbles survive cancel. Not listed as a known limitation in CHANGELOG.md / docs/acceptance-evidence.md (grep "clear-all"/"cancel" finds nothing relevant).

Partially refuted details (do not count toward severity):
- "sticky 緊急氣泡" cannot be wiped by an AI cancel: after estop every open receipt is transitioned to Stopped (terminal per receipt.rs:46-56 → `cancel_action` returns Conflict) and the bridge pending set is cleared (presentation.rs:813 `clear_pending`), so no `cancel` PresentationCommand can be produced post-estop; and the sticky emergency bubble is shown on the `emergency.stop` event, which is sequenced AFTER the `clear-all` (same EventBus, monotonic sequence, interaction-events/src/lib.rs:40-56; runtime.rs:889-896 actuator loop precedes 924 `emit(EmergencyStop)`).
- The estop-ordering half is true in code (clear-all → clear-transient before base=emergency; scratch test confirms the transient ends up null in both orderings, so regressions-phase7 #8's "keep blocked" guarantee is dead in the real flow) but has no observable effect: with base=emergency `pose()` returns "emergency" regardless of transient (machine.ts:~306), the Roll Call label prefers base (CompanionApp.tsx:1109-1114), `machineStageFlags` freezes on base (rig/stage.ts:291), and the single bubble slot would be replaced by the sticky emergency bubble anyway. It only makes test #8 pin an internal state that the real pipeline never preserves.

verdicts.reasoning:
Reproduced against the current working tree with a scratchpad vitest probe (config root=app dir, jsdom, same setup.ts) — no repo files modified.

Code evidence (all read directly):
- stage.ts: `frozen` is only consumed as a stepWorld input (l.665) and in the walking/gaze overlays (l.698, 715). `spawnToy` (501-503), `pointerDown` (552-563), `pointerMove` (571-590), `pointerUp` (592-603) have no frozen/base check.
- playfield.ts: header l.8 promises "frozen（緊急/離線/暫停）：一切凍結"; `stepWorld` returns early at l.253, so a toy spawned at `ground-60` (l.178) never falls. `grabToyAt`/`dragToy`/`releaseToy` (200-238) carry no state guard; `releaseToy` sets `interest:1, cooldownUntil:0` and stores the drag velocity.
- CompanionApp.tsx: `onPointerUp` l.1671-1672 does `apply({type:"transient",kind:"clicked"})` then unconditionally `setMenuOpen(v=>!v)`; machine.ts l.251-256 drops the transient under emergency/offline but the menu still toggles. Toy row (l.1878-1886) is gated only on `menuOpen && toyCatalog.length>0`; `quickToy` (1760-1773) → shu.ts `gameplay.spawnToy` (397-403) → `stage.spawnToy` with no base check. `<canvas>` pointer handlers (onPointerDown l.1559+) have no estop gate; the only estop UI effects are the bubble class and the "緊急停止中" label (l.1800-1810). The emergency transition at l.495 only calls `stopSpeech()`; nothing clears/locks toys. Uncommitted diff to these files refactors the toy bar to be adapter-driven and adds no gate.
- Draw pass l.742/761 draws every toy regardless of frozen.

Probe results (stage under `machineStageFlags("emergency",…)`): spawnToy → toy at y=150 (ground-60 at 416x216), unchanged after 3 s of renderFrame; one frozen frame issued 408 ctx calls (toy is drawn); pointerDown on toy → "toy"; pointerMove(300,100) → toyPoints {x:300,y:100}, playerGrabbedToys()=1; pointerUp then 1 s frozen → still {300,100}; after switching flags to idle, 10 frames later toy at {x:366.9,y:40.7} i.e. it flies off with the velocity captured during estop. Pure playfield probe: dragToy(300,100) + frozen stepWorld → toy {x:300,y:100,grabbed:"player"} exactly as the finding's probe states; releaseToy under frozen keeps vx=250/vy=-80, interest=1, cooldown=0.

Not covered by existing tests: playfield.test.ts:87 only freezes an already-thrown toy; regressions-phase7.test.ts:280 only checks char x. No test exercises spawn/drag/menu under frozen.

One overstatement in the finding: "立刻被追" is not guaranteed — chase is hazard-sampled (rng); with rng=0.5 the character stayed in mode "free". The toy becomes chase-eligible (interest 1, cooldown 0) but the chase itself is probabilistic. Core claim stands regardless.

Severity: low is correct — purely local canvas presentation, no external side effect, no safety-sovereignty breach; it contradicts the module's own "一切凍結" contract, machine.ts's "停住的系統不繼續演任何東西", and spec §15.2 "emergency 搶占所有遊戲動畫" in spirit (user-driven toy motion and a mid-air spawn displayed during estop, then a velocity-carrying launch the instant estop clears).

confirmed.regressionTest: StageRenderer with machineStageFlags("emergency"): spawnToy must leave toyCount()===0 (or place it resting on ground), pointerDown on an existing toy must not return "toy"/grab it, and a toy released while frozen must have zero velocity after flags return to idle (toyPoints unchanged over the next 10 frames); plus a CompanionApp test that a click under baseState==="emergency" does not open the toy row.

DERIVED_EXIT` 補齊。

confirmed.title: Attention／Utility Scoring 在生產路徑是死碼：scoreEvent 只在同優先級平手時以常數情境呼叫且結果恆為 replace；Director.score() 無人呼叫；第二套微動作排程器只存在於測試
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/machine.ts:135-145 (transientCompetition 121-146；行號未漂移，HEAD 2e02284 與工作樹相同)；director.ts:148-150；behavior.ts:182, 232；character/adapters/shuTables.ts:115；docs/FEATURES.md:155；CHANGELOG.md:150, 207-209
confirmed.claim: spec §6 的「Attention Manager → Utility Scoring」在實際程式裡沒有作用：(1) `Director.score()` 沒有任何生產呼叫者；(2) `scoreEvent` 唯一的生產呼叫在 `transientCompetition`，僅在兩個 transient PRIORITY 相等且非同一事件時執行，而 PRIORITY 表中所有同分配對（succeeded/unknown、clicked/dragged、waiting-for-receipt/acting）在 CLASS_OF 都屬同一 class，計算永遠是 nextScore = activeScore + 8 → 恆為 replace；EventScoreContext 的 recentSameClass／alreadyResponded／doNotDisturb／relevance 在整個 codebase 從未被真實狀態填入（只有 machine.ts 的常數）。實際決定舞台的只有靜態優先階梯。(3) behavior.ts 的 `scheduleMicroAction` 與 shuTables 的 `SHU_MICRO_ACTIONS` 是與 Director.tick 平行的第二套 ambient 排程器，只被測試引用，且沒有 isPlayable 白名單；FEATURES.md 卻宣稱 Director 有「注意力、utility 競爭」。
confirmed.evidence: grep 全 src（排除 test）：`\.score(`／`scheduleMicroAction`／`SHU_MICRO_ACTIONS` 只出現在 director.ts:148-150、behavior.ts:232、shuTables.ts:115 與 src/test/*。machine.ts:135-145：`const base = { recentSameClass: 0, alreadyResponded: false, interruptible: true, doNotDisturb: false, relevance: 1, novelty: 0 }; const activeScore = scoreEvent(CLASS_OF[active.kind], base); const nextScore = scoreEvent(CLASS_OF[next.kind], { ...base, novelty: 1 }); return nextScore > activeScore ? "replace" : "keep";`。machine.ts:49-63 PRIORITY 與 :68-82 CLASS_OF：succeeded=unknown=60 皆 task-state；clicked=dragged=55 皆 direct-interaction；waiting-for-receipt=acting=40 皆 task-state。我在 scratchpad 用 vitest 枚舉 13×13 全部 kind 配對，同優先級配對回 keep 的數量為 0。docs/FEATURES.md:155「**Interaction Director**：注意力、utility 競爭、…」。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自驗證，主張全部成立，但影響僅為死碼＋文件超額宣稱，無執行期錯誤行為，故降為 low。

(1) Director.score()：grep 全 src（排除 test）`\.score(` 只有 director.ts:148 定義；src/test 也無呼叫。tick()/react() 內部不用 scoreEvent。→ 完全死碼。

(2) scoreEvent 生產路徑：唯一呼叫在 machine.ts:143-144，且只在 PRIORITY 相等、非 repeat 時執行，情境是常數（recentSameClass:0／alreadyResponded:false／doNotDisturb:false／relevance:1，只有 novelty 0 vs 1）。CLASS_OF（68-82）讓所有同分配對同 class（succeeded/unknown=task-state、clicked/dragged=direct-interaction、waiting-for-receipt/acting=task-state）。我用 esbuild 打包 scratchpad 腳本枚舉 13×13 全部配對：counts keep=75/refresh=13/replace=81；等優先相異配對共 6 組全部雙向 replace；scoring 分支回 keep 的次數＝0；succeeded(verified)←succeeded(claimed) 與 performing(x)←performing(y) 也恆 replace；同 class 分數恆為 base+10 vs base+18。companion.test.ts:249-258 正是釘死 replace，因此現有測試無法察覺評分是 no-op。attention.ts 雖傳入真實 doNotDisturb，但那是 QuietInputs（quiet 基態閘門），不是 EventScoreContext；EventScoreContext 其餘欄位在生產程式無任何來源。personality.ts 也沒有任何 score 關聯，spec §4.3（line 163）「個性必須影響 Utility score」未實作。

(3) scheduleMicroAction（behavior.ts:232）與 SHU_MICRO_ACTIONS（shuTables.ts:115）只被 src/test/behavior.test.ts 引用；SHU_DIRECTOR_TABLES 用的是 SHU_AMBIENT_VARIANTS。CHANGELOG.md:207-208 已自述 Director「取代舊 scheduleMicroAction 路徑」，所以這部分是已知的殘留死碼而非隱藏的第二套排程器；缺 isPlayable 白名單因未被生產呼叫而無實際影響。

(4) 文件：FEATURES.md:155 宣稱 Director 有「utility 競爭」；CHANGELOG.md:150 在 Fixed 段把「scoreEvent 接進 App」列為 Phase 7 修正（對應 :208-209 的 Phase 2 已知限制），但接線後行為等價於直接 return "replace"，等於用 no-op 關掉了一項已知限制；CHANGELOG／acceptance-evidence 均未把「utility scoring 未生效」記為已知限制。

已修復檢查：git diff HEAD 對 machine/behavior/director 只有 behavior.ts 一行註解涉及此主題，transientCompetition 在 HEAD 與工作樹完全相同 → 未被並行修復。

嚴重度：實際決策由靜態 PRIORITY 階梯完成，安全搶佔與誠實階梯不受影響，無使用者可見錯誤；問題本質是死碼＋文件／CHANGELOG 超額宣稱＋spec 階段未實作且未列為已知限制。依專案「文件誠實」原則值得修（刪死碼或真接線並補已知限制），但影響不到 medium。

confirmed.title: 隱藏角色的兩條路徑不一致：companion_apply_prefs（控制中心「顯示角色」開關）只 hide 視窗，不像 toggle_companion_window 那樣主動告訴 Runtime 表面已隱藏
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:2303 (companion_apply_prefs hide branch; function starts at 2271; toggle_companion_window counterpart at 1798-1829)
confirmed.claim: tray 的 toggle_companion_window 在 hide 之後明確呼叫 `presentation_hello_with_behavior(visible=false)`，並在註解說明理由：「不等 WebView 自己的心跳（隱藏後不保證會送）」，這樣 Presentation receptors 才會依 spec §6.1 停止。但控制中心「顯示角色」開關（CompanionPage patch → companionApplyPrefs）走的 companion_apply_prefs 在 `!visible` 時只 `w.hide()`，沒有同樣的通知；receptor／actuator 健康是否轉為 `companion hidden` 完全仰賴被隱藏 WebView 的 visibilitychange／10 秒心跳——依 repo 自己的判斷那是不保證的。兩條路徑對同一件事（隱藏角色）有不同的誠實度。
confirmed.evidence: lib.rs:1795-1826 toggle_companion_window：`let _ = w.hide(); // 角色被隱藏時 Presentation receptors 必須停止（spec §6.1）：直接告訴 Runtime 這個表面不在了，不等 WebView 自己的心跳（隱藏後不保證會送）。 ... runtime.presentation_hello_with_behavior(visible, Some(pack), None)`。lib.rs:2185-2216 companion_apply_prefs：`} else if let Some(w) = app.get_webview_window("companion") { let _ = w.hide(); }` 後直接 `Ok(())`，無 runtime 呼叫、無 emit。CompanionPage.tsx:141-145 `patch`：`await desktop.prefsPatch(p); await desktop.companionApplyPrefs();`，:298-299 顯示角色開關即走此路。presentation.rs:365-381 actuator/receptor 健康只看 bridge 的 `s.visible`（由 hello 更新）。

verdicts.reasoning: Verified at HEAD 2e02284 by reading the files. toggle_companion_window (lib.rs:1798-1829) hides the window and then explicitly spawns `runtime.presentation_hello_with_behavior(visible=false, Some(pack), None)` plus emits `companion-visibility`, with the comment that the hidden WebView's own heartbeat is not guaranteed. companion_apply_prefs (lib.rs:2271-2305, line drifted from the finding's 2214) on the `!visible` branch is exactly `else if let Some(w) = app.get_webview_window("companion") { let _ = w.hide(); }` then `Ok(())` — no runtime hello, no emit. The control-center「顯示桌面角色」toggle (CompanionPage.tsx:298-300 → patch() at :141-145) calls desktop_prefs_patch (lib.rs:1618, validate+save only, no visibility side-effect) then companion_apply_prefs, and no other code on that path calls presentationHello(false). So after hiding via the control centre, the Runtime's presentation bridge (presentation.rs:365-381, health keyed solely on `s.visible`/freshness) only learns the surface is gone if the hidden WebView's visibilitychange/10s setInterval beat (CompanionApp.tsx:1140-1169, sends `!document.hidden`) fires, or after PRESENCE_STALE_SECS=20 s staleness (with reason "not connected" rather than "companion hidden"). Spec line 250 requires receptors to stop and Runtime to stay in a correct state when the character is hidden; the repo's own comment says relying on the WebView for this is not guaranteed, yet one of the two entry points for the same user intent relies on it anyway. No Rust or vitest test covers companion_apply_prefs → hide → runtime hello(false). Refutation attempts: not already fixed (gap present at HEAD), not a Phase-7 partial fix (toggle hello dates from v0.4 commit 7cc2abd), not test-covered, not stylistic — it is a concrete functional asymmetry in how runtime presence state is updated. Severity stays low: on macOS WKWebView orderOut does normally fire visibilitychange so the practical window is small, and the worst case is only a stale "healthy" health report for a hidden surface, not an external side-effect.

confirmed.regressionTest: Extract a shared `set_companion_visible(app, false)` helper used by both toggle_companion_window and companion_apply_prefs, and assert that after calling it (with no WebView hello at all) `bridge.actuator_health(PresentationKind::BubbleShow, now)` is Offline("companion hidden") immediately.

confirmed.title: Director 的 currentAction 在 performing→performing 替換時既不 notePreempted 也不 noteFinished，之後的真實搶佔會依早已下台的動作排「恢復」
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/CompanionApp.tsx:486-493 (apply) and :1271-1276 (pump); machine.ts:158-166 (wasPreempted); director.ts:159-174 (notePreempted)
confirmed.claim: CompanionApp 只在 `wasPreempted(before, after)` 為真時通知 Director 被搶佔，而 wasPreempted 明確排除 after.kind === "performing"；pump 的 noteFinished 也只在 t.kind 不再是 performing 時觸發。因此 Director 排的 ambient（如 legswing 6s）被另一個 performing（legacy 的 device-hello／operate-tool、CPP 的 notice/greet/play intent、落地演出）以同優先級 replace 後，Director.currentAction 仍指向舊動作；當那個新 performing 再被 clicked 等真實事件搶佔時，notePreempted 用舊動作的 startedAt/durationMs 計算 remaining 並建立恢復計畫，之後 Director 會 resume 一個其實早被別的表演換掉的動作（與 Gateway 的 resume-previous 也可能互相競爭）。
confirmed.evidence: CompanionApp.tsx:486-493：`const after = machineRef.current.transient; if (wasPreempted(before, after, now)) { behaviorState.current = noteInterruption(...); directorRef.current.notePreempted(now); }`；machine.ts:163-166 wasPreempted：`if (!before || before.kind !== "performing") return false; if (before.untilMs <= nowMs) return false; return after !== null && after.kind !== "performing";`；CompanionApp.tsx:1270-1276 `if (performingRef.current && t?.kind !== "performing") { performingRef.current = false; directorRef.current.noteFinished(); } else if (t?.kind === "performing") { performingRef.current = true; }`；machine.ts:121-146 同優先級（performing 25 vs performing 25）不同 animation → replace。scratchpad vitest 重現：Director.tick 給 legswing(6000ms) → reduce performing legswing → +500ms reduce performing device-hello（pose 變 device-hello，wasPreempted=false）→ +1000ms reduce clicked（wasPreempted=true → notePreempted）→ +2000ms Director.tick 回 `{ expression: 'legswing', durationMs: 5000, source: 'resume' }`。

verdicts.reasoning: Verified against the current working-tree files (line numbers in the claim still match; the file is uncommitted-modified but this region is unchanged). Code facts: (1) CompanionApp.tsx:490-492 only calls directorRef.notePreempted when wasPreempted() is true; machine.ts:165 returns false whenever `after.kind === "performing"`, and regressions-phase7.test.ts:596-601 deliberately pins performing→still-running-performing as "不記". (2) pump at CompanionApp.tsx:1271-1276 calls noteFinished only when the active transient is no longer `performing`, so a same-priority replace (PRIORITY performing=25 vs 25, different animation → scoreEvent novelty +8 → "replace", machine.ts:121-146/262-283) leaves Director.currentAction pointing at the replaced ambient. (3) director.ts notePreempted uses currentAction.startedAt/durationMs and builds `interrupted` with source "resume"; noteFinished only nulls currentAction and does not clear `interrupted`; tick() resumes `interrupted` first. Nothing else clears currentAction except react()/setTables(). Not listed in CHANGELOG.md / docs/acceptance-evidence.md as a known limitation. Reproduced with a scratchpad vitest harness that mirrors the real apply()/pump()/tick wiring using the real modules (InteractionDirector, reduce, wasPreempted, mapRuntimeEvent with SHU_EVENT_ART, SHU_DIRECTOR_TABLES) — 4/4 tests pass: Director schedules legswing(6000) at T0 → at +500 legacy provider.state-changed→device-hello performing replaces it (transient.animation becomes "device-hello", no notePreempted) → +1000 clicked → notePreempted fires and computes remaining=5000 from legswing's start → +1500 noteFinished (plan survives) → +2000 Director.tick with rng=0.99 (hazard cannot fire) returns `{expression:"legswing", durationMs:5000, source:"resume"}` and the machine goes back to legswing. Same result with real SHU tables and a CPP-style direct `performing: greet` replace (adapter mixer path, shu.ts:312-318, bypasses Director.react): the resumed action is the Director's old ambient, not greet. Severity assessment: this is an internal bookkeeping inconsistency with only ambient-layer effect — a control test shows the identical resume happens without the intervening performance, so the user-visible difference is merely "an ambient action the design already declared 正常收場 comes back after a click", possibly stacked after a Gateway resume-previous of the CPP intent (Gateway resumePolicy defaults to "none", so that competition only arises when runtime explicitly sends resume-previous). No honesty-ladder, truthState, estop or safety implications (Director only schedules isPlayable expressions). Hence confirmed at low, as filed.

confirmed.regressionTest: Director.tick → performing A (≥4s); reduce a different same-priority `performing` B while A still runs (assert wasPreempted=false, transient.animation===B); then reduce `clicked`; after clicked expires, Director.tick with rng=0.99 must return null (no resume of A) — today it returns {expression:A, source:"resume"}.

- 回歸證據：git show 1b2be19 / a898996 的 CompanionApp.tsx:1001-1003 onIntent 直接 `apply({type:"transient", kind:"performing", animation: intent, durationMs:2500})`，thinking 姿勢當時會演；2e02284（Phase 7）改經 director.react() 但 REACTION_EXPRESSIONS（Phase 2 c1a66f7 建立）從未含 thinking。CHANGELOG 只寫「director.react() 接進 App」，沒有記載刻意拿掉 L1 思考姿勢；其他 4 個 L1 intent 都保留，只有 thinking 掉了，屬遺漏而非設計。
- 無測試覆蓋：agent-intent.test.ts:92-96 只驗 suggestDelegate 與 reply 文字，沒斷言 behaviorIntent；rig.test / character-shu-adapter.test 只驗 SHU_REACTIONS 內的值可播，沒驗「L1 provider 發出的 intent 都在表內」。
- 嚴重度維持 low：使用者仍看到氣泡回覆（「這聽起來像個任務…」），只是伴隨表情消失；不涉真相狀態或安全。

【Claim (2) 只部分成立，核心「不開選單」是文件化設計】
- 程式行為屬實：CompanionApp.tsx:1657-1669 連戳 ≥3 次一律 react("poked-rapid")，回 null 就 `return`，不做 clicked transient、不切換選單。重現：預設 cooldownScale=1.065 → t=0 播 poked-rapid，t=2300（2.2s 動畫已結束）與 t≈7999×scale 皆 null，t≈8001×scale 才再播；lazy 個性 cooldownScale 可到 1.565（冷卻 12.5s，上限 2.0→16s）。EMPTY_DIRECTOR_TABLES（sprite/text 角色，CompanionApp.tsx:978 `shu?.directorTables ?? EMPTY_DIRECTOR_TABLES`）永遠 null。
- 但 CHANGELOG.md:345「連戳 ≥3 次＝poked-rapid 抗議、不再狂開關選單」明示連戳不切選單是設計；finding 把「也不開選單」當缺陷不成立。
- finding 對 director.ts 註解的解讀有誤：「冷卻中回 null（不重播）」本身就寫明冷卻回 null；「那也是一個誠實的反應」指的是 pretend-not-hear 分支（會演出可見表情），不是冷卻分支。
- 感測不靜默面向未被違反：pushInteraction("companion-clicked")（CompanionApp.tsx:558-570）在 return 前已送出（protocol 模式 gateway.ingestInput；legacy 模式 pushObservation），runtime 端看得到每次點擊。
- 殘餘的「抗議動畫結束後到冷卻到期前（約 2.2s→8.5s，lazy 個性更長）連續快點無任何可見回饋；sprite/text 角色第 3 次起快點完全無視覺」是 UX 判斷（角色抗議過一次後短暫不理，可以是個性），規格 §207 只要求高頻反應具冷卻，未規定冷卻期必須有替代回饋，我不將此獨立列為缺陷。

結論：以 (1) 為主體 confirmed，severity low；(2) 建議在修 (1) 時順帶決定冷卻期是否退回 clicked transient（設計選擇），但「不開選單」與註解矛盾兩點應視為 refuted。
